cases.description: Standard Webhooks minimum key length enforcement (16-byte key rejected by Hooklatch, accepted by vendor SDK)
cases.divergenceReason: Hooklatch enforces strict MIN_KEY_BYTES = 24 bound on Standard Webhooks secrets to protect against weak symmetric keys, failing at option validation with invalid-secret. The vendor SDK permits arbitrary key lengths.
cases.evidenceReference: Hooklatch MIN_KEY_BYTES bound in src/providers/standard-webhooks.ts vs standardwebhooks Webhook constructor in dist/index.js

cases.divergenceReason: Hooklatch trims segment whitespace around semicolons per standard header robustness, successfully recognizing "h1"; @paddle/paddle-node-sdk splits on ";" without trimming, yielding key " h1" which fails parameter matching and throws Invalid webhook signature.
cases.evidenceReference: Hooklatch segment.trim() in src/providers/paddle.ts vs @paddle/paddle-node-sdk WebhooksValidator.extractHeader

cases.description: Paddle Billing multiple h1 signature values where first signature is valid
cases.divergenceReason: Hooklatch evaluates repeated h1 fields as a secret rotation accept-set; Paddle Node SDK loops and overwrites "h1", checking only the final h1 value.
cases.evidenceReference: Hooklatch rotation accept-set in src/providers/paddle.ts vs @paddle/paddle-node-sdk WebhooksValidator.extractHeader
